expected_outcomes: Research evidence, assumptions, and hypotheses remain distinguishable.
required_actions: Record method, boundaries, findings, confidence, response, and questions.
acceptance: Participant counts and outcomes are not invented.
verification: Review the source and research record.
evidence: Research source or clearly labelled assumption.
failure_conditions: Unobserved metrics or findings are represented as evidence.
exceptions: Record a research limitation and owner for follow-up.
